html:
This 7 day private journey offers a well balanced exploration of Southern and Central Vietnam, combining coastal relaxation, highland scenery, desert landscapes, and river life in the Mekong Delta. Travelers will experience the vibrant seaside city of Nha Trang, the cool climate and flower filled hills of Da Lat, the golden sand dunes of Mui Ne, and the cultural richness of the Mekong Delta before concluding in Ho Chi Minh City.

Price: USD 520 / pax (based on 2 persons)

DAY 1: ARRIVAL IN NHA TRANG – CITY TOUR

Meals: Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Nha Trang

Upon arrival at Cam Ranh International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by Vietlook Travel’s English-speaking guide and transferred by private car to Nha Trang city.

Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, offering an introduction to the fresh and flavorful coastal cuisine of Nha Trang.

In the afternoon, begin a gentle city exploration:

  • Local Coffee Experience: Relax at a local café and enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee, a key part of daily life in Vietnam.

  • Nha Trang Cathedral (Stone Church): A French Gothic-style church located on a small hill, reflecting the city’s colonial heritage.

  • Po Nagar Cham Towers: An ancient Cham temple complex built before 781 A.D., representing the spiritual and architectural legacy of the Cham civilization.

  • Dam Market: The largest local market in Nha Trang, ideal for purchasing local specialties and souvenirs.

At 18:30, enjoy dinner at a local restaurant.

Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Nha Trang.

DAY 2: NHA TRANG – DA LAT

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, depart at 08:30 for Da Lat, traveling through scenic mountain roads and highland landscapes.

En route and upon arrival, visit:

  • Cau Dat Tea Plantation: A vast tea farm surrounded by rolling hills, famous for its fresh air and green scenery.

  • Linh Phuoc Pagoda: One of Da Lat’s most impressive Buddhist temples, entirely decorated with intricate mosaic artwork.

  • Da Lat Railway Station: Built in 1932 by French architects Moncet and Reveron, this is the oldest railway station in Vietnam.

  • Stairway to Heaven (Nấc Thang Lên Thiên Đường): A popular viewpoint and photo spot overlooking Da Lat’s countryside.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Visit Xuan Huong Lake, Da Lat Square, enjoy coffee at Doha Coffee, and free time at Big C Supermarket.

  • Check in at your hotel in Da Lat.

Dinner at 18:00.

Optional visit to Da Lat Night Market.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 3: DA LAT FULL DAY SIGHTSEEING

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

Breakfast at the hotel.

At 08:30, begin a full day of sightseeing:

  • Datanla Waterfall: A lively natural attraction with multiple small waterfalls, surrounded by pine forest (optional adventure activities available).

  • Tuyen Lam Lake: A peaceful lake set among pine-covered hills, offering beautiful scenery and fresh air.

  • Happy Hills: A scenic lakeside area ideal for photography and relaxation.

  • Hydrangea Flower Farm: Expansive hillside flower fields showcasing Da Lat’s most iconic blooms.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Van Thanh Flower Village: One of Da Lat’s largest flower-growing villages, famous for roses and vegetables.

  • Hoa Son Dien Trang: A popular eco-tourism site known for its forest setting and unique photo spots.

  • Mê Linh Coffee Farm: Enjoy coffee while overlooking coffee plantations and countryside views.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 4: DA LAT – MUI NE | SUNSET TOUR

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Mui Ne

Breakfast at the hotel.

Check out at 08:30 and transfer to Mui Ne by private car.

Arrive around 12:00, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, then check in and relax.

At 15:00, join the Mui Ne sunset tour:

  • Fairy Stream: A shallow stream surrounded by colorful sand formations in shades of red, white, orange, and pink.

  • Mui Ne Fishing Village: Observe daily coastal life, fishing boats, and local fishermen at work.

  • Red Sand Dunes: Gentle slopes offering beautiful sunset views and excellent photo opportunities.

At 18:00, enjoy a BBQ seafood dinner at a local restaurant.

Return to hotel.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 5: MUI NE – MEKONG DELTA – HO CHI MINH CITY

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Ho Chi Minh City

After breakfast, depart at 07:30 for the Mekong Delta.

Arrive in My Tho and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Board a motorboat to Phoenix Island (Con Phung).

  • Take a horse cart ride to a cultural performance area to enjoy Đờn Ca Tài Tử, a traditional Southern Vietnamese folk music recognized by UNESCO, along with seasonal tropical fruits.

  • Cruise on a traditional hand-rowing boat through narrow canals shaded by coconut trees.

  • Visit a bee-keeping farm to taste honey tea.

  • Stop at a coconut candy workshop to learn about local handicrafts.

At 17:00, return to Ho Chi Minh City by private car.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 6: HO CHI MINH CITY – FREE TIME / OPTIONAL EXPLORATION

Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Free day at leisure for shopping, walking around the city, or optional tours.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 7: HO CHI MINH CITY – DEPARTURE

Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Private transfer to the airport for your departure.

TOUR PRICE: USD 520 / PERSON (2 PAX)

Included:

  • Private air-conditioned transportation

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Meals: 5 lunches & 4 dinners

  • Entrance fees as mentioned

  • 5 nights in 3-star hotels

  • Mekong Delta boat trips

  • Airport transfers

Not Included:

  • Jeep ride at sand dunes

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses
